shared_elements: face- or mask-like motifs with circular eye/disc elements
justification: The strongest correspondence is the use of schematic curvilinear figures and mask/face-like forms built around round eye or disc elements, with possible bird-human/animal iconography on both surfaces. The main difference is that B is organized as an axial standing anthropomorphic figure with symmetrical torso/face features, while A appears as scattered, overlapping petroglyph motifs without the same overall figure or layout.
